philosophy: Same authentic macOS Vorssaint UI/UX design identity. Maximum functional parity. Zero fake buttons or simulated sliders. Where OS sandboxing prevents exact reproduction, provide genuinely useful, native platform-exclusive replacements.

macos.description: Per-process volume attenuation and software gain overdrive past 100% up to 200%.

windows.implementation: Native PowerShell and Win32 Core Audio endpoints adjust master volume and individual audio session volumes. Overdrive boosted via software audio gain.

android.restriction: Android kernel sandboxing blocks non-system apps from adjusting individual third-party process volumes.

replacement.name: System Media Stream Controller & Equalizer
replacement.description: Granular control of Android audio streams (Media, Call, Ring, Alarm, Notification) plus 5-band Equalizer and Bass Boost using android.media.audiofx.Equalizer.

ios.restriction: iOS sandbox strictly prohibits adjusting volumes of other apps.

replacement.name: AVFoundation Audio Lab & Spatial Focus Generator
replacement.description: Binaural white/pink/brown noise generator for deep work, live decibel sound level meter via AVAudioRecorder.averagePower, and high-fidelity Voice Memo capture.

replacement.name: Multi-Track Audio Focus Hub
replacement.description: Ambient focus soundscape mixer with independent channels (Rain, Waves, Fire, White Noise) with multi-touch volume sliders on iPad.

macos.description: Hardware backlight adjustment and sub-zero extra dimming.

windows.implementation: Direct WMI backlight control for integrated screens; software black-overlay dimming for external DDC/CI desktop monitors.

android.restriction: Modifying system-wide global brightness requires WRITE_SETTINGS permission; in-app brightness changes apply to window.

replacement.name: Sub-Zero Night Dimmer & Blue Light Filter
replacement.description: Software color-matrix overlay (Night Light) reducing blue wavelengths and lowering brightness below device hardware minimum for night reading.

ios.api: UIScreen.main.brightness (read/write within active app) & software night filter
ios.restriction: iOS allows UIScreen brightness modification while app is active, but prevents background global overrides.

replacement.name: OLED True Black Dimmer & Reading Filter
replacement.description: Zero-power OLED pure black (#000000) canvas and warm amber tint filter for night use without eye strain.

replacement.name: Apple Pencil Low-Glare Paper Mode
replacement.description: High-contrast monochrome paper tone optimization for comfortable Apple Pencil sketching and reading.

windows.implementation: Active power blocker keeps Windows display and CPU awake for 15m, 1h, 4h, or indefinite.

android.implementation: Foreground wake lock keeps screen on while active; quick settings tile provides 1-tap toggling.

ios.implementation: Disables device idle timer to prevent display dimming or auto-locking during presentations and timers.

ipados.implementation: Keeps iPad screen active on desk or stand indefinitely while docked.

features.name: Clipboard History Shelf & Sensitive Key Masking

macos.description: Encrypted local clipboard history with API key auto-masking.

windows.implementation: Continuous background clipboard monitoring with regex masking for AWS, GitHub, OpenAI, and Anthropic tokens.

android.restriction: Android 10+ restricts background apps from reading clipboard unless default IME or active accessibility service.

replacement.name: Authorized Clipboard Vault & Tap-to-Share
replacement.description: Foreground clipboard shelf with Quick Settings tile paste trigger, sensitive secret redaction, and 1-tap copy.

ios.api: UIPasteboard.general with user paste action / Share Extension
ios.restriction: iOS displays system paste banner and disallows background clipboard access.

replacement.name: Secure Snippets Library & Share Sheet Receiver
replacement.description: Curated library of frequently used snippets, links, and markdown notes accessible via iOS Share Sheet and in-app shelf without paste banner harassment.

replacement.name: iPadOS Drag-and-Drop Floating Shelf
replacement.description: Multi-window floating shelf supporting drag-and-drop of text, images, and URLs directly from Safari and Notes in Split View.

macos.api: CGEventTap intercepting keyboard and trackpad events
macos.description: Locks keyboard input for wiping dust without accidental keystrokes.

windows.api: Fullscreen transparent Electron window (cleaning_mode.html) with key-event absorption
windows.implementation: Transparent fullscreen overlay capturing and preventing default on all keystrokes, with 30s countdown and triple-Esc unlock.

android.restriction: Touchscreens don't have physical key cavities that gather debris; cleaning mode is touch rejection.

replacement.name: Screen Wipe Lock & Speaker Water Ejector
replacement.description: Locks all capacitive touch input with triple-tap unlock, plus 165Hz acoustic frequency pulse to eject water droplets and dust from speaker grilles.

ios.restriction: iPhones have capacitive touchscreens, not mechanical key switches.

replacement.name: Sonic Speaker Cleaner & Touch Lock
replacement.description: Emits targeted low-frequency resonant tones (165Hz–220Hz) through iPhone speakers to dislodge dust and water, accompanied by a touch-freeze wiping card.

ipados.implementation: Intercepts external Magic Keyboard and Smart Keyboard Folio keystrokes, and freezes touchscreen for microfiber screen cleaning.

macos.description: Spotlight-style launcher for math, conversions, emoji, apps.

windows.implementation: Instant math calculator, unit converter (km, mi, kg, lbs), emoji search, snippet lookup, and web search fallback.

replacement.name: Android Quick Command Sheet & App Shortcuts
replacement.description: Swipe-up glass bottom sheet with live math evaluator, currency/unit converter, and quick launch shortcuts for frequently used Android apps.

ios.api: SwiftUI .sheet() & App Intents / Spotlight Search Indexing

replacement.name: iOS Spotlight Actions & Interactive Command Sheet
replacement.description: Integrates directly into iOS native Spotlight via App Intents and CoreSpotlight, plus an in-app pull-down command sheet.

ipados.implementation: Hardware keyboard ⌘K opens floating Spotlight bar identical to macOS, supporting trackpad cursor navigation.

features.name: Dynamic Island Notch HUD & Companion Mascot

macos.description: Hardware cutout HUD, pearl mascot (● ●), media strip, audio visualizer.

windows.implementation: Screen-saver level top-center capsule, expandable on hover or click, interactive mascot rig with 7 palettes and 7 moments, live visualizer.

android.api: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW overlay capsule / notch pill in PWA
android.implementation: Android camera hole-punch notch capsule simulation adhering to DisplayCutout, expandable with media controls and companion pet.

ios.implementation: Genuine native iOS Dynamic Island implementation in VorssaintIslandActivity.swift for iPhone 14 Pro/15/16 series, plus in-app capsule for all devices.

ipados.implementation: Top-center glass capsule on iPad displays live audio playback, system statistics, and companion mascot without obstructing Stage Manager.

macos.description: Active TCP port listener and process termination.

windows.implementation: Parses listening TCP ports, extracts PID and process name, and terminates orphan dev servers (Node, Vite, Python, Next.js).

android.restriction: Android kernel sandboxing does not allow non-root apps to execute lsof/netstat on system sockets or kill other PIDs.

replacement.name: Network Health Sentinel & Latency Analyzer
replacement.description: Tests gateway ping, DNS resolution latency, public IP lookup, Wi-Fi link speed (RSSI), and cellular signal strength.

ios.restriction: iOS strictly forbids accessing system process tables or socket states of other applications.

replacement.name: Network Route & Connectivity Health Monitor
replacement.description: Monitors active connection type (Wi-Fi / 5G / Cellular), DNS latency, IPv6 reachability, and zero-packet loss testing.

replacement.name: iPad Pro Network Diagnostics & Local Device Discovery
replacement.description: Diagnoses Wi-Fi 6E/7 throughput, LAN gateway responsiveness, and AirDrop peer readiness.

macos.description: Snaps active window to halves, quarters, center, and fullscreen.

windows.api: Win32 MoveWindow & ShowWindow via PowerShell / C# P/Invoke
windows.implementation: Snaps the most recent foreground window to Left Half, Right Half, Top, Bottom, Fullscreen, Quarters, and Center.

android.restriction: Android manages window splitting through native OS gesture and system multi-window manager.

replacement.name: Picture-in-Picture & Split Screen Helper
replacement.description: 1-tap Picture-in-Picture trigger for video/companion, and split-screen companion docking.

ios.restriction: iPhones do not support window splitting; apps run in single fullscreen or Picture-in-Picture.

replacement.name: Focus Mode & Deep Work Timer
replacement.description: Pomodoro focus timer with ambient soundscape integration and Apple Focus Filter triggers.

ipados.api: NavigationSplitView & iPadOS Stage Manager / Split View support
ipados.implementation: Adaptive multi-column layout seamlessly responding to Stage Manager resizing, iPad Split View (50/50, 70/30), and Slide Over.

macos.description: Removes utm_*, fbclid, gclid from pasted URLs.

windows.implementation: Strips 18+ surveillance and tracking query parameters while preserving legitimate query params.

android.implementation: Available via Android Share Sheet ('Clean URL with Vorssaint') and in-app utility card.

ios.implementation: Available via iOS Action Extension, Siri Shortcut App Intent, and in-app utility card.

ipados.implementation: Drag any link into Vorssaint shelf to clean tracking params immediately.
